name: Albedo-based Parameterization for Extinction
definition: A parameterization strategy where the scattering coefficient is given as an albedo volume paired with sigma_t, decoupling the two to keep optimization gradients stable, avoiding the instability of sigma_s / sigma_t derivatives as extinction goes to zero.
summary: Albedo-based Parameterization for Extinction decouples scattering from extinction to ensure stable gradient flow during differentiable volume rendering optimization, avoiding the numerical instability of direct scattering coefficient optimization.
